## 318. § * (1) Whoever

a) provides or collects material resources to ensure the conditions for a terrorist act,
b) supports with material resources a person preparing to commit a terrorist act, or the perpetrator of a terrorist act, or another person in consideration of such persons, or
c) provides or collects material resources for the purpose of supporting the persons specified in point b),
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from two to eight years.  
(2) Whoever commits the offence specified in paragraph (1) in connection with the commission of a terrorist act in a terrorist group or in the interest of a member of a terrorist group, or otherwise supports the activity of a terrorist group, or provides or collects material resources for the purpose of such support of a terrorist group, shall be punishable by imprisonment from five to ten years.  
318/A. § * (1) Whoever
a) provides or collects material resources to ensure the conditions for a terrorist-type offence,
b) supports with material resources a person preparing to commit a terrorist-type offence, or the perpetrator of a terrorist-type offence, or another person in consideration of such persons, or
c) provides or collects material resources for the purpose of supporting the persons specified in point b),
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment up to three years.  
(2) For the purposes of paragraph (1), a terrorist-type offence is:
a) homicide [Section 160 (1), Section 160 (2), if the act is directed against a person present at an airport serving international civil aviation or on board an aircraft in flight or on a ship at sea, or against an internationally protected person],
b) bodily harm (Section 164, if the act is directed against a person present at an airport serving international civil aviation or on board an aircraft in flight or on a ship at sea, or against an internationally protected person),
c) kidnapping [Section 190 (1)–(4)],
d) offence against the safety of transport (Section 232, if the act is directed against an aircraft or a ship at sea).  
e) illicit trafficking in radioactive material (Section 250),
f) sabotage (Section 257),
g) violence against an internationally protected person (Section 313),
h) seizure of control of a vehicle (Section 320),
i) causing public danger [Section 322 (1)–(3)],
j) disruption of the operation of a public utility (Section 323),
k) illicit trafficking in explosives or blasting agents (Section 324, if the act is committed on the premises of a public utility or a public building or structure),
l) illicit trafficking in firearms or ammunition (Section 325, if the act is committed on the premises of a public utility or a public building or structure).  
318/B. § *

## 319. §

* (1) For the purposes of Sections 314–315, Section 316/A and Section 318, a terrorist group is a group consisting of three or more persons, organised for a longer period, operating in a coordinated manner, the purpose of which is to commit a terrorist act.  
(2) For the purposes of Section 316/A, Section 318 and Section 318/A, material resources means the resources, legal documents and instruments defined in Article 1(1) of Council Regulation (EC) No 2580/2001 of 27 December 2001 on specific restrictive measures directed against certain persons and entities with a view to combating terrorism.

## 320. §

(1) Whoever seizes control of an aircraft, a vehicle for mass transport or mass freight transport by violence, threat, or by rendering another person unconscious or incapable of defence, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from five to ten years.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment from ten to twenty years or life imprisonment if the offence causes death.  
(3) Whoever commits preparation for the seizure of control of a vehicle shall be punishable by imprisonment from two to eight years.  
(4) The punishment of a person who abandons the offence before serious consequences have resulted may be reduced without limitation.

## 321. §

(1) Whoever incites, offers, undertakes to commit an offence in a criminal organisation, agrees on joint commission, or provides the necessary or facilitating conditions for the purpose of facilitating the commission, or otherwise supports the activity of the criminal organisation, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from one to five years.  
(2) A person who reports the offence to the authorities and discloses the circumstances of the commission before the offence comes to the knowledge of the authorities shall not be punishable for participation in a criminal organisation.

## 322. §

(1) Whoever causes public danger by triggering the destructive effect of matter or energy, or obstructs the prevention of public danger or the mitigation of its consequences, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from two to eight years.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment from five to ten years if the offence is committed
a) in a group,
b) causing particularly large or greater damage, or
c) in complicity.  
(3) The punishment is imprisonment from five to twenty years or life imprisonment if the offence causes death.  
(4) Whoever commits preparation for causing public danger shall be punishable by imprisonment up to three years.  
(5) Whoever commits the causing of public danger by negligence shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment up to three years, in case of particularly large or greater damage from one to five years, in case of causing death from two to eight years.  
(6) The punishment of a person who voluntarily eliminates the public danger before harmful consequences have resulted may be reduced without limitation.  
322/A. § * (1) Whoever obstructs the implementation of
a) epidemiological isolation, observation, quarantine or control ordered to prevent the introduction or spread of an infectious disease subject to quarantine obligation,
b) epidemiological isolation, observation, quarantine or control ordered during an epidemic,
c) plant health or animal health measures ordered to prevent or eliminate the introduction and spread of infectious animal diseases or plant quarantine pests,
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment up to three years.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment from one to five years if the offence is committed in a group.  
(3) The punishment is imprisonment from two to eight years if the offence causes death.  
(4) Whoever commits preparation for obstructing epidemiological measures shall be punishable by imprisonment up to one year.

## 323. §

(1) Whoever disrupts the operation of a public utility to a significant extent shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from one to five years.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment from two to eight years if the offence is committed
a) in a group,
b) in complicity, or
c) causing particularly large damage.  
(3) The punishment is imprisonment from five to ten years if the offence is committed
a) armed,
b) in an armed state, or
c) causing particularly significant damage.  
(4) Whoever commits preparation for disrupting the operation of a public utility shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment up to two years.  
(5) Whoever commits the offence by negligence shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment up to three years, in case of causing particularly large or greater damage from one to five years.

## 324. §

(1) Whoever
a) manufactures, acquires, possesses, places on the market, or transfers to a person not authorised to possess explosives, blasting agents or devices for their use without authorisation,
b) brings into, takes out of, or transports through the territory of the country without authorisation or exceeding the limits of authorisation,
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from two to eight years.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment from five to ten years if the offence is committed as a business or in complicity.  
(3) Whoever commits preparation for illicit trafficking in explosives or blasting agents shall be punishable by imprisonment up to three years.

## 326. § (1) Aki nemzetközi szerződés által tiltott fegyvert

(7) Aki a (2) bekezdésben írt bűncselekményt gondatlanságból követi el, vétség miatt két évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.

## 327. §

(1) Aki Magyarország nemzetközi jogi kötelezettsége alapján kihirdetett, illetve az Európai Unió Működéséről szóló Szerződés 75. cikke és 215. cikke alapján elfogadott rendeletekben vagy e rendeletek felhatalmazása alapján elfogadott rendeletekben vagy határozatokban, valamint az Európai Uniót létrehozó szerződés 29. cikke alapján elfogadott tanácsi határozatokban elrendelt

(2) A büntetés két évtől nyolc évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha a nemzetközi gazdasági tilalom megszegését

## 325. § (1) Whoever

a) * acquires or possesses an operational firearm without authorization,
b) manufactures or places a firearm on the market without authorization,
c) * brings an operational firearm into the territory of the country, takes it out of the country, or transports it through the country without authorization or exceeding the limits of the authorization,
d) * exceeds the limits of the authorization relating to the manufacture of, trade in, or acquisition or possession of an operational firearm,
e) transfers a firearm held with authorization to a person not having authorization,
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from two to eight years.  
(2) Whoever shall be punishable pursuant to paragraph (1)
a) acquires or possesses ammunition belonging to a handgun, hunting firearm or sport firearm exceeding a small quantity, or ammunition belonging to another firearm, without authorization,
b) manufactures or places ammunition on the market without authorization,
c) brings ammunition into the territory of the country, takes it out of the country, or transports it through the country without authorization or exceeding the limits of the authorization,
d) exceeds the limits of the authorization relating to the manufacture, acquisition, possession or trade of ammunition,
e) transfers ammunition belonging to a handgun, hunting firearm or sport firearm held with authorization exceeding a small quantity, or ammunition belonging to another firearm, to a person not having authorization.  
(3) The punishment shall be imprisonment from five to ten years if the offense is committed on a commercial basis or in a criminal organization.  
(4) Whoever brings a handgun, hunting firearm or sport firearm held with authorization, or ammunition belonging thereto, into the territory of the country, takes it out of the country, or transports it through the country without notification, shall be punishable for a misdemeanor by imprisonment up to two years.  
(5) * Whoever commits preparation for an offense defined in paragraphs (1)–(3) shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment up to three years.  
(6) For the purposes of this Section, small quantity means ammunition not exceeding ten pieces.

## 326. § (1) Whoever

a) develops, manufactures,
b) acquires, possesses, uses, unlawfully renders harmless,
c) transfers to a person not authorized to possess it, brings into the territory of the country, takes out of the country, transports through the country, or places on the market,
a weapon prohibited by international treaty shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from five to fifteen years.  
(2) Whoever, without authorization or in deviation from the authorization, constructs or operates a facility suitable for the production of weapons prohibited by international treaty, or converts an existing facility for the purpose of manufacturing such weapons, shall be punishable pursuant to paragraph (1).  
(3) Whoever
a) provides technical support for the development, manufacture, assembly, quality testing, operation, maintenance or repair of weapons prohibited by international treaty,
b) deceives the authority or person entitled to decide in order to obtain the authorization specified by law for the operation of a facility suitable for the production of weapons prohibited by international treaty,
shall be punishable by imprisonment from five to ten years.  
(4) The punishment shall be imprisonment from five to fifteen years if the offense defined in paragraph (3) is committed
a) on a commercial basis,
b) in a criminal organization, or
c) as an official person.  
(5) Whoever
a) commits the offense defined in paragraph (1) on a commercial basis, or
b) commits the offense defined in paragraphs (1)–(2) in a criminal organization or as an official person,
shall be punishable by imprisonment from ten to twenty years or life imprisonment.  
(6) Whoever commits preparation for abuse of weapons prohibited by international treaty shall be punishable by imprisonment from one to five years.  
(7) Whoever commits the offense described in paragraph (2) by negligence shall be punishable for a misdemeanor by imprisonment up to two years.

## 327. §

(1) Whoever violates
a) the obligation to freeze funds or economic resources, or
b) an economic, commercial or financial prohibition
ordered on the basis of Hungary's international legal obligation as promulgated, or in regulations or decisions adopted pursuant to Articles 75 and 215 of the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union or in regulations or decisions adopted on the basis of authorization by these regulations, as well as in Council decisions adopted pursuant to Article 29 of the Treaty establishing the European Union, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from one to five years.  
(2) The punishment shall be imprisonment from two to eight years if the violation of the international economic prohibition is committed
a) in connection with trade in goods applicable during the execution of the death penalty, torture or other cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment,
b) with violence, or
c) as an official person.  
(3) The punishment shall be imprisonment from five to ten years if the violation of the international economic prohibition is committed
a) in connection with trade in firearms, ammunition, explosives, explosive devices, devices for their use or other products intended for military use,
b) while armed, or
c) in a criminal organization.  
(4) Whoever commits preparation for violation of an international economic prohibition shall be punishable by imprisonment up to three years.  
(5) * For the purposes of this Section – unless the legislation promulgating the obligation or prohibition provides otherwise on the basis of the international legal obligation –
a) funds shall mean the assets defined in Article 1(l) of Council Regulation (EU) No 267/2012 of 23 March 2012 concerning restrictive measures against Iran and repealing Regulation (EU) No 961/2010 (hereinafter in this paragraph: Regulation (EU) No 267/2012),
b) freezing of funds shall mean what is defined in Article 1(k) of Regulation (EU) No 267/2012,
c) economic resources shall mean the assets defined in Article 1(h) of Regulation (EU) No 267/2012,
d) freezing of economic resources shall mean the assets defined in Article 1(j) of Regulation (EU) No 267/2012,
e) * goods applicable during the death penalty, torture or other cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment shall mean the goods defined in Annex II of Regulation (EU) 2019/125 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 16 January 2019 concerning trade in certain goods which could be used for capital punishment, torture or other cruel, inhuman or degrading treatment or punishment (hereinafter for the purposes of this Chapter: Regulation (EU) 2019/125 of the European Parliament and of the Council).

## 328. §

(1) Whoever obtains credible knowledge that a violation of an international economic prohibition is being prepared, or that such an offense not yet uncovered has been committed, and does not report it to the authorities as soon as possible, shall be punishable for a misdemeanor by imprisonment up to one year.  
(2) A relative of the perpetrator shall not be punishable for failure to report a violation of an international economic prohibition.

c) a lakosság egyes csoportjai, illetve azok tagjai ellen – különösen fogyatékosságra, nemi identitásra, szexuális irányultságra tekintettel –
erőszakra vagy gyűlöletre uszít, bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.

## 333. §

* Aki nagy nyilvánosság előtt a nemzetiszocialista vagy kommunista rendszerek által elkövetett népirtás vagy más, emberiesség elleni cselekmények tényét tagadja, kétségbe vonja, jelentéktelen színben tünteti fel, vagy azokat igazolni törekszik, bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.

## 334. §

Aki nagy nyilvánosság előtt Magyarország himnuszát, zászlaját, címerét vagy a Szent Koronát sértő vagy lealacsonyító kifejezést használ, illetve azokat más módon meggyalázza, ha súlyosabb bűncselekmény nem valósul meg, vétség miatt egy évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.

## 335. §

* Aki horogkeresztet, SS-jelvényt, nyilaskeresztet, sarló-kalapácsot, ötágú vöröscsillagot vagy ezeket ábrázoló jelképet a köznyugalom megzavarására alkalmas – különösen az önkényuralmi rendszerek áldozatainak emberi méltóságát vagy kegyeleti jogát sértő – módon
a) terjeszt,
b) nagy nyilvánosság előtt használ, vagy
c) közszemlére tesz,
ha súlyosabb bűncselekmény nem valósul meg, vétség miatt elzárással büntetendő.

## 336. §

Aki nagy nyilvánosság előtt, a köznyugalom megzavarására alkalmas módon hatóság rendelkezése ellen általános engedetlenségre uszít, bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.

## 337. §

* (1) Aki közveszély színhelyén nagy nyilvánosság előtt a közveszéllyel összefüggésben olyan valótlan tényt vagy való tényt oly módon elferdítve állít vagy híresztel, amely a közveszély színhelyén alkalmas az emberek nagyobb csoportjában zavar vagy nyugtalanság keltésére, bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.  
(2) Aki különleges jogrend idején nagy nyilvánosság előtt olyan valótlan tényt vagy való tényt oly módon elferdítve állít vagy híresztel, amely alkalmas arra, hogy a védekezés eredményességét akadályozza vagy meghiúsítsa, bűntett miatt egy évtől öt évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.

## 338. §

(1) Aki a köznyugalom megzavarására alkalmas olyan valótlan tényt állít, híresztel, vagy azt a látszatot kelti, hogy közveszéllyel járó esemény bekövetkezése fenyeget, bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.  
(2) A büntetés egy évtől öt évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha a közveszéllyel fenyegetés a köznyugalmat súlyosan megzavarta.

## 339. §

(1) Aki olyan kihívóan közösségellenes, erőszakos magatartást tanúsít, amely alkalmas arra, hogy másokban megbotránkozást vagy riadalmat keltsen, ha súlyosabb bűncselekmény nem valósul meg, vétség miatt két évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.  
(2) A büntetés bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha a garázdaságot
a) csoportosan,
b) a köznyugalmat súlyosan megzavarva,
c) fegyveresen,
d) felfegyverkezve vagy
e) * nyilvános rendezvényen vagy gyűlésen
követik el.

## 329. § (1) Whoever

a) manufactures, places on the market, or provides military technology services without authorisation or exceeding the scope of the authorisation,
b) uses military technology products in a manner different from the authorisation,
c) produces, acquires, uses, possesses, transfers, places on the market, brings into the territory of the country, takes out of it, or transports through it prohibited military technology products,
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from two to eight years.  
(2) Whoever shall be punishable pursuant to paragraph (1):
a) provides technical support in connection with the development, manufacture, trade, maintenance, repair, detection, identification or proliferation of chemical, biological or nuclear weapons, other nuclear explosives, or missile technology equipment capable of delivering them,
b) provides technical assistance in connection with other military use, other than that set out in point (a), in relation to a country subject to arms export restrictions binding on Hungary under international commitments.  
(3) The punishment shall be imprisonment from five to ten years if the offence defined in paragraph (1) is committed in a criminal organisation or on a commercial basis.  
(4) Whoever commits preparation for the abuse of military technology products or services shall be punishable by imprisonment from one to five years.  
(5) For the purposes of this Section:
a) authorisation shall also mean the International Import Certificate and the documents replacing them,
b) * military technology product shall also mean the goods specified in Annex III to Regulation (EU) 2019/125 of the European Parliament and of the Council,
c) * prohibited military technology product means the goods specified in Annex II to Regulation (EU) 2019/125 of the European Parliament and of the Council.

## 330. § (1) Whoever

a) places dual-use items in foreign trade without authorisation or exceeding the scope of the authorisation, including their transfer within the customs territory of the European Union, or
b) uses dual-use items in a manner different from the authorisation,
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from one to five years.  
(2) The punishment shall be imprisonment from two to eight years if the offence defined in paragraph (1) is committed
a) * in connection with chemical substances falling within the scope of Annex 1 to Act LXIII of 2020 on the promulgation of the amendment to the Annex to the Convention on the Prohibition of the Development, Production, Stockpiling and Use of Chemical Weapons and on their Destruction, signed in Paris on 13 January 1993, being brought into the territory of Hungary or transferred from there to the customs territory of the European Union, or
b) in relation to nuclear dual-use items.  
(3) Whoever commits preparation for the abuse of dual-use items shall be punishable by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(4) For the purposes of this Section:
a) authorisation shall also mean the International Import Certificate and the documents replacing them,
b) dual-use item means a product as defined in Article 2(1) of Regulation (EC) No 428/2009 setting up a Community regime for the control of exports, transfer, brokering and transit of dual-use items,
c) * the customs territory of the European Union means the territory defined in Article 4 of Regulation (EU) No 952/2013 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 9 October 2013 laying down the Union Customs Code.

## 331. §

* (1) Whoever incites to war before a large public, or otherwise conducts war propaganda, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from one to five years.  
(2) Whoever, if a more serious offence is not committed, incites to the support of terrorism before a large public, or otherwise conducts propaganda supporting terrorism, shall be punishable pursuant to paragraph (1).

## 332. § * Whoever before a large public

a) against the Hungarian nation,
b) against any national, ethnic, racial, religious group or a member thereof, or
c) against certain groups of the population or their members – in particular on the grounds of disability, gender identity, sexual orientation –
incites to violence or hatred, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment for up to three years.

## 333. §

* Whoever before a large public denies, questions, presents in an insignificant light, or seeks to justify the fact of genocide or other crimes against humanity committed by the National Socialist or Communist regimes, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment for up to three years.

## 334. §

Whoever before a large public uses an insulting or degrading expression concerning the anthem, flag, coat of arms or the Holy Crown of Hungary, or otherwise desecrates them, if a more serious offence is not committed, shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment for up to one year.

## 335. §

* Whoever disseminates, uses before a large public, or displays publicly a swastika, SS insignia, arrow cross, hammer and sickle, five-pointed red star or symbols depicting them in a manner capable of disturbing public order – in particular in a manner violating the human dignity or funeral rights of the victims of totalitarian regimes –
a) disseminates,
b) uses before a large public, or
c) displays publicly,
if a more serious offence is not committed, shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by confinement.

## 336. §

Whoever before a large public, in a manner capable of disturbing public order, incites to general disobedience against an order of an authority, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment for up to three years.

## 337. §

* (1) Whoever at the scene of a public danger, before a large public, in connection with the public danger, asserts or spreads a false fact or distorts a true fact in such a manner that is capable of causing confusion or unrest among a larger group of people at the scene of the public danger, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(2) Whoever during a special legal order, before a large public, asserts or spreads a false fact or distorts a true fact in such a manner that is capable of hindering or frustrating the effectiveness of defence, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from one to five years.

## 338. §

(1) Whoever asserts or spreads a false fact capable of disturbing public order, or creates the appearance that an event involving public danger is threatening to occur, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment for up to three years.  
(2) The punishment shall be imprisonment from one to five years if the threat of public danger has seriously disturbed public order.

## 339. §

(1) Whoever engages in provocatively anti-social, violent conduct capable of causing outrage or alarm in others, if a more serious offence is not committed, shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment for up to two years.  
(2) The punishment shall be imprisonment for up to three years for a felony if the disorderly conduct is committed
a) in a group,
b) seriously disturbing public order,
c) while armed,
d) while equipped with weapons, or
e) * at a public event or assembly.

## 340. §

(1) * Whoever resists with violence or threat the lawful measures taken by the organiser or steward of a public event or assembly for the purpose of maintaining order, if a more serious criminal offence is not committed, shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding two years.
(2) If a more serious criminal offence is not committed, whoever at a sports event unlawfully enters or stays in an area of the facility that is closed off from spectators or from a specified group of spectators, or throws into such area an object endangering the holding of the sports event or the physical integrity of others, shall be punishable according to paragraph (1).
(3) The punishment shall be imprisonment not exceeding three years for a felony if the disturbance of order is committed
a) in a group,
b) while armed,
c) while equipped with weapons, or
d) as a special recidivist,
e) * in violation of the restrictions ensuring the peaceful nature of the assembly under the Act on the right of assembly.
(4) For the purposes of special recidivism, criminal offences of a similar nature are
a) bodily harm [Section 164 paragraphs (3)–(6) and (8)],
b) violence against an official [Section 310 paragraphs (1)–(5)], violence against a person performing a public duty (Section 311), violence against a supporter of an official or a person performing a public duty (Section 312),
c) hooliganism (Section 339),
d) vandalism [Section 371 paragraphs (1)–(6)].

## 341. §

The perpetrator of hooliganism and disturbance of order may also be subject to a ban.

## 342. § (1) Whoever

a) produces a false public document or falsifies the content of a public document,
b) uses a false, falsified or genuine public document issued in another person's name,
c) participates in having false data, facts or statements concerning the existence, modification or termination of a right or obligation recorded in a public document,
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment not exceeding three years.
(1a) * The criminal offence under paragraph (1) point c) shall not be committed in relation to the registration of an address in the register containing the personal and address data of citizens, if it is done with the consent of the accommodation provider or by registration at a property owned by the person.
(2) Whoever commits preparation for forgery of public documents as defined in paragraph (1) points a) or b) shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding one year.
(3) Whoever commits the forgery of public documents as defined in paragraph (1) point c) by negligence shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by confinement.

## 343. § (1) An official who, abusing his or her official authority,

a) produces a false public document,
b) falsifies the content of a public document, or
c) falsely records a material fact in a public document,
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from one year to five years.
(2) The provisions of this Section shall also apply accordingly to a member of a foreign state's authority performing judicial or law enforcement tasks who acts on the territory of Hungary on the basis of law.
343/A. § * (1) Whoever
a) issues a document that can be confused with a diploma certifying qualifications obtained in higher education or a certificate certifying qualifications obtained in non-formal education or in school-based vocational training, or
b) unlawfully confers a
ba) diploma certifying qualifications,
bb) academic degree,
bc) title, or
bd) abbreviation
as defined in the Act on national higher education or that can be confused with such,
shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding two years.
(2) Whoever commits the criminal offence defined in paragraph (1) in a criminal organisation or on a commercial basis shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment not exceeding three years.

## 344. § Whoever

a) produces a false security document authorising entry as defined in separate legislation,
b) falsifies the content of a security document authorising entry,
c) uses a false, falsified or genuine security document authorising entry issued in another person's name,
if a more serious criminal offence is not committed, shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding two years.

## 345. §

Whoever uses a false, falsified or false-content private document to prove the existence, modification or termination of a right or obligation shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding one year.

## 346. §

* (1) Whoever, in relation to one or more public documents that are not or not exclusively his or her own,
a) unlawfully obtains them from another person without that person's consent,
b) unlawfully destroys or damages them, or
c) unlawfully takes them from another person or unlawfully conceals them from the person entitled,
shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding two years.
(2) If another criminal offence is not committed, whoever transfers or receives a public document for the purpose of unlawful gain shall be punishable according to paragraph (1).
(3) Whoever commits the criminal offence defined in paragraph (1) in relation to a private document in order to obtain an unlawful advantage or cause an unlawful disadvantage shall be punishable by imprisonment not exceeding one year.

## 347. § (1) Whoever

a) removes or falsifies a unique identification mark,
b) obtains, uses or disposes of an object whose unique identification mark is false, falsified, or whose unique identification mark has been removed,
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment not exceeding three years.
(2) The punishment shall be imprisonment from one year to five years if the criminal offence defined in paragraph (1) is committed on a commercial basis or in a criminal organisation.
(3) For the purposes of this Section, unique identification mark means: the marking applied by the manufacturer or the authority on an object, or on a component thereof, the possession or intended use of which is subject to official authorisation by law, serving for unique identification.

## 348. §

Whoever, for the purpose of unlawful gain, falsifies the value indicated by the odometer of a road motor vehicle by influencing the instrument or by affecting the measurement process, or prevents the operation of the instrument, if a more serious criminal offence is not committed, shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding one year.

## 349. § * (1) Whoever

a) for the purpose of acquiring ownership of agricultural and forestry land,
b) for the purpose of establishing a usufruct right or right of use over agricultural and forestry land
concludes a void contract by circumventing the statutory prohibition or restriction relating to these, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from one year to five years.
(2) Whoever
a) for the acquisition of ownership of agricultural and forestry land,
b) for the establishment of a usufruct right or right of use over agricultural and forestry land
uses agricultural and forestry land or collects its benefits on the basis of an agreement created to conceal a void contract concluded by him or her by circumventing a statutory prohibition or restriction, if a more serious criminal offence is not committed, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment not exceeding three years.
(3) * A lawyer, chamber legal counsel or notary public who participates in the conclusion of a contract under paragraph (1) shall be punishable according to paragraph (1).
(4) The punishment of the perpetrator of the criminal offence under paragraphs (1) and (2) may be reduced without limitation if he or she reports the criminal offence to the authority before it comes to the authority's knowledge and discloses the circumstances of the commission.
349/A. § * (1) Whoever concludes an agreement as a result of which the result of a competition or match organised in the competition system of a sports federation or otherwise included in the competition calendar of the sports federation is not formed in accordance with the competition rules or the principles of fair play, if another criminal offence is not committed, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment not exceeding three years.
(2) The punishment shall be imprisonment from one year to five years if the criminal offence is committed in a criminal organisation or on a commercial basis.

## 350. §

* (1) Anyone who, during an election, referendum or European Citizens' Initiative falling under the scope of the Act on Electoral Procedure or the Act on the Initiation of Referendums, European Citizens' Initiatives and Referendum Procedure,
a) obtains endorsements in violation of the rules of the nomination procedure by means of violence, threat, deception or material benefit,
b) obtains signatures by means of violence, threat, deception or material benefit for the purpose of initiating a referendum or European Citizens' Initiative,
c) votes without entitlement,
d) signs without authorization or provides false data,
e) obstructs a person entitled to participate in the election, referendum, referendum initiative or European Citizens' Initiative, or seeks to influence them by means of violence, threat, deception or material benefit,
f) violates the secrecy of the election or referendum,
g) falsifies the result of the election, referendum, referendum initiative or European Citizens' Initiative,
h) accepts material benefit for their endorsement during the nomination procedure, or for their signature during the initiation of a referendum or European Citizens' Initiative,
i) makes their vote conditional on the provision of material benefit and accepts material benefit in this regard,
commits a felony and is punishable by imprisonment not exceeding three years.  
(2) *
350/A. § * A member, responsible person or executive officer of a nominating organization within the meaning of the Act on Electoral Procedure, as well as a candidate within the meaning of the Act on Electoral Procedure, who uses prohibited foreign support or a pecuniary advantage derived from an agreement concealing the origin of prohibited foreign support for the purpose of circumventing this prohibition, is punishable by imprisonment not exceeding three years for a felony.

## 351. §

(1) Anyone who participates in the leadership of an association dissolved by a court, if a more serious criminal offence is not committed, is punishable by imprisonment not exceeding three years for a felony.  
(2) Anyone who participates in the operation of an association dissolved by a court in a manner capable of disturbing public order is punishable by imprisonment not exceeding two years for a misdemeanour.  
(3) Anyone who provides conditions necessary for or facilitating the leadership or operation of an association dissolved by a court, or provides material resources for it, is punishable by imprisonment not exceeding one year.

## 352. § Anyone who

a) organizes activities aimed at maintaining public safety or public order for which they are not authorized by law, or
b) organizes activities creating the appearance of maintaining public safety or public order,
is punishable by imprisonment not exceeding two years for a misdemeanour.  
352/A. § * (1) Anyone who unlawfully enters the territory of Hungary protected by a facility ensuring the protection of the state border order through the facility is punishable by imprisonment not exceeding three years for a felony.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment from one year to five years if the felony defined in paragraph (1) is committed
a) while armed,
b) while equipped with weapons,
c) as a participant in a riot.  
(3) Anyone who commits the felony defined in paragraph (1) as a participant in a riot while armed or equipped with weapons is punishable by imprisonment from two years to eight years.  
(4) The punishment is imprisonment from five years to ten years if the felony defined in paragraph (2) or (3) causes death.  
352/B. § * (1) Anyone who destroys or damages a facility or device ensuring the protection of the state border order, if a more serious criminal offence is not committed, is punishable by imprisonment from one year to five years for a felony.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment from two years to eight years if the felony defined in paragraph (1) is committed
a) while armed,
b) while equipped with weapons,
c) as a participant in a riot.  
(3) Anyone who commits the felony defined in paragraph (1) as a participant in a riot while armed or equipped with weapons is punishable by imprisonment from five years to ten years.  
(4) The punishment is imprisonment from ten years to twenty years if the felony defined in paragraph (2) or (3) causes death.  
352/C. § * Anyone who obstructs work related to the construction or maintenance of a facility ensuring the protection of the state border order, if another criminal offence is not committed, is punishable by imprisonment not exceeding one year for a misdemeanour.

## 353. §

(1) * Anyone who provides assistance to another person for crossing the state border in violation of legal provisions is punishable by imprisonment from one year to five years for a felony.  
(2) * The punishment is imprisonment from two years to eight years if the smuggling of migrants is committed
a) for pecuniary gain,
b) by providing assistance to multiple persons for crossing the state border, or
c) by destroying or damaging a facility or device ensuring the protection of the state border order.  
(3) * The punishment is imprisonment from five years to ten years if the smuggling of migrants is committed
a) by mistreating the smuggled person,
b) while armed,
c) while equipped with weapons,
d) as a business, or
e) in a criminal organization.  
(4) * The punishment is imprisonment from five years to fifteen years if
a) the smuggling of migrants under paragraph (3) point a) is committed in the manner specified in points b)–e)
b) the smuggling of migrants under paragraph (3) point b) is committed in the manner specified in point a) or points c)–e).  
(5) * The organizer or director of the criminal offence defined in paragraph (3) or (4) is punishable by imprisonment from ten years to twenty years.  
(6) * Anyone who commits preparation for smuggling of migrants is punishable by imprisonment not exceeding three years.  
353/A. § * (1) Anyone who participates in enabling another person to initiate asylum or other proceedings in Hungary allowing the acquisition of a residence title by making a false statement or concealing a true fact regarding a circumstance materially affecting the official procedure, or to make a false statement or conceal a true fact regarding a circumstance materially affecting the official procedure in such proceedings, if a more serious criminal offence is not committed, is punishable by detention for a misdemeanour.  
(2) The organizer of the criminal offence defined in paragraph (1) is punishable by imprisonment not exceeding one year.  
(3) Anyone who commits the criminal offence defined in paragraph (1)
a) for pecuniary gain, or
b) by providing assistance to multiple persons
is punishable under paragraph (2).  
(4) Anyone who provides material resources for the commission of the criminal offence defined in paragraph (1) or paragraph (2) is punishable under paragraph (2).  
(5) Criminal proceedings for the criminal offences defined in paragraphs (1)–(4) may be initiated only on the basis of a complaint by the authority conducting the underlying case in which the criminal offences were committed, as long as that underlying case has not been concluded. Except for the case of such a complaint, the limitation period for the criminal offences defined in paragraphs (1)–(4) begins on the day the underlying case is concluded.  
(6) The perpetrator of the criminal offence defined in paragraph (1) is not punishable if
a) in the event of disclosure of the truth, the subject of the official procedure would accuse themselves or their relative of committing a criminal offence, or
b) they report the criminal offence to the authority and disclose the circumstances of its commission before it comes to the attention of the authority.  
(7) The punishment may be reduced without limitation – and in cases deserving special consideration may be waived – for the perpetrator of the criminal offence defined in paragraphs (2)–(4) if they report the criminal offence to the authority and disclose the circumstances of its commission before it comes to the attention of the authority.

bűntettet miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.  
(2) Az (1) bekezdés szerint büntetendő, aki a kulturális javak körébe tartozó és kiviteli engedélyhez kötött tárgyat engedély nélkül külföldre juttat, vagy a kiviteli engedély kereteit túllépi.

## 359. § (1) Aki

a) veszélyes állatot engedély nélkül tart, szaporít, elidegenít, vagy az ország területére behoz,
b) a veszélyes állat tartására vonatkozó jogszabályban előírt biztonsági előírást megszegi,
vétség miatt két évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.  
(2) Az (1) bekezdés szerint büntetendő, aki
a) veszélyes ebet
aa) szaporít, az ország területére behoz, onnan kivisz, versenyeztet, vagy engedély nélkül tart,
ab) jogszabály megszegésével elidegenít vagy megszerez, illetve
b) a veszélyes eb
ba) ivartalanítására vonatkozó jogszabályban előírt kötelezettségét megszegi, vagy
bb) tartására vonatkozó jogszabályban előírt biztonsági előírást megszegi.  
(3) Aki veszélyes ebet őrző-védő feladat végzésére tart, kiképez, illetve veszélyes ebbel ilyen feladatot végeztet, bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.  
(4) E § alkalmazásában veszélyes eb a hatósági határozatban egyedileg veszélyes ebbé nyilvánított eb.

## 360. § * Aki

a) tiltott szerencsejátékot rendszeresen szervez,
b) tiltott szerencsejáték rendszeres szervezéséhez helyiséget vagy eszközt bocsát rendelkezésre, vagy
c) tiltott szerencsejátékban való részvételre nagy nyilvánosság előtt felhív,
bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.

## 361. § Aki *

a) a zárlati kötelezettség alá tartozó fertőző betegség behurcolásának vagy terjedésének megakadályozása végett elrendelt járványügyi elkülönítés, megfigyelés, zárlat vagy ellenőrzés szabályait megszegi,
b) járvány idején az elrendelt járványügyi elkülönítés, megfigyelés, zárlat vagy ellenőrzés szabályait megszegi,
c) a fertőző állatbetegségek vagy növényi zárlati károsítók be- és kihurcolásának, valamint terjedésének megakadályozása vagy előfordulásának felszámolása végett elrendelt növény-egészségügyi vagy állatjárványügyi intézkedés szabályait megszegi,
vétség miatt elzárással büntetendő.

## 362. § Aki az Európai Unióban

a) engedéllyel nem rendelkező géntechnológiával módosított növényfajta szaporítóanyagát az ország területére jogellenesen behozza, tárolja, szállítja, forgalomba hozza, vagy a környezetbe kijuttatja,
b) termesztési célú felhasználásra ki nem terjedő engedéllyel rendelkező géntechnológiával módosított növényfajta szaporítóanyagát a környezetbe jogellenesen kijuttatja,
c) termesztési célú engedéllyel rendelkező géntechnológiával módosított növényfajta szaporítóanyaga vonatkozásában a védzáradéki eljárás időtartamára biztonsági intézkedésként elrendelt behozatali, előállítási, tárolási, szállítási, forgalomba hozatali, felhasználási tilalmat megszegi,
vétség miatt két évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.

## 363. §

(1) Aki az Állami Számvevőszék ellenőrzése során az Állami Számvevőszékről szóló törvényben meghatározott közreműködési kötelezettségét megszegi, és ezzel az ellenőrzés lefolytatását akadályozza, vétség miatt két évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.  
(2) Az (1) bekezdés szerint büntetendő az ellenőrzött szervezet vezetője, ha írásbeli felszólítás ellenére nem küld intézkedési tervet az Állami Számvevőszék részére.  
(3) A büntetés bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha az (1) bekezdésben meghatározott cselekmény az ellenőrzés lefolytatását meghiúsítja.

## 364. §

* Az embercsempészés, a határzár tiltott átlépése, a határzár megrongálása, a határzárral kapcsolatos építési munka akadályozása, a jogellenes tartózkodás elősegítése, a jogellenes bevándorlás elősegítése, támogatása és a tiltott szerencsejáték szervezése elkövetőjével szemben kitiltásnak is helye van.
translated_text:
## 354. § (1) Whoever

a) in the territory of a Member State of the European Union,
b) in another state party to the Agreement on the European Economic Area, or
c) in the territory of a state whose nationals have the same legal status as nationals of another state party to the Agreement on the European Economic Area
provides assistance for the purpose of obtaining pecuniary gain to a person who is not a national of any of these states for illegal residence, if a more serious criminal offence is not committed, shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding two years.  
(2) If a more serious criminal offence is not committed, whoever provides assistance for the purpose of obtaining pecuniary gain for the illegal residence in Hungary of a foreign person shall be punishable according to paragraph (1).

## 355. §

A person who has reached the age of eighteen who establishes a family relationship solely for the purpose of obtaining a document certifying the right of residence for the purpose of material gain, or consents to a declaration of acknowledgement with full legal effect establishing paternity, if a more serious criminal offence is not committed, shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding two years.

## 356. § (1) Whoever employs *

a) a third-country national regularly or permanently, or
b) a significant number of third-country nationals simultaneously
who do not hold a permit issued for the purpose of work, shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding two years.  
(2) Whoever
a) * employs a third-country national who does not hold a permit issued for the purpose of work under particularly exploitative working conditions,
b) *
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment not exceeding three years.  
(3) For the purposes of this Section
a) * particularly exploitative working conditions shall mean the concepts defined in the Act on the general rules on the entry and residence of third-country nationals;  
b) significant number: at least five persons.

## 357. §

(1) Whoever damages a monument, an object belonging to the category of protected cultural property or an archaeological site located on his or her own property shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment not exceeding three years.  
(2) Whoever
a) destroys a monument or an object belonging to the category of protected cultural property in his or her ownership,
b) causes irreparable damage to a monument as a result of which it loses its monumental character, or
c) causes irreparable damage to an object belonging to the category of protected cultural property or to an archaeological site,
shall be punishable by imprisonment from one year to five years.  
(3) * Whoever commits the criminal offence defined in paragraphs (1)–(2) in relation to a foreign protected cultural heritage element in his or her ownership shall be punishable according to paragraphs (1)–(2).

## 358. § (1) Whoever

a) alienates an object belonging to a protected collection or a piece of a protected ensemble of objects without prior consent prescribed by law,
b) fails to fulfil the obligation prescribed by law to notify of a change in the ownership of an object, collection or ensemble of objects belonging to the category of protected cultural property,
c) takes abroad an object, collection or ensemble of objects belonging to the category of protected cultural property without authorisation, or exceeds the limits of the export authorisation,
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment not exceeding three years.  
(2) Whoever takes abroad an object belonging to the category of cultural property and subject to export authorisation without authorisation, or exceeds the limits of the export authorisation, shall be punishable according to paragraph (1).

## 359. § (1) Whoever

a) keeps, breeds, alienates or brings into the territory of the country a dangerous animal without authorisation,
b) violates the safety regulations prescribed by law for the keeping of dangerous animals,
shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding two years.  
(2) Whoever
a) with regard to a dangerous dog
aa) breeds, brings into or takes out of the territory of the country, competes, or keeps without authorisation,
ab) alienates or acquires in violation of law, or
b) with regard to a dangerous dog
ba) violates the obligation prescribed by law for neutering, or
bb) violates the safety regulations prescribed by law for keeping,
shall be punishable according to paragraph (1).  
(3) Whoever keeps, trains a dangerous dog for the performance of guarding or protection tasks, or performs such tasks with a dangerous dog, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment not exceeding three years.  
(4) For the purposes of this Section, a dangerous dog is a dog individually declared a dangerous dog by an official decision.

## 360. § * Whoever

a) regularly organises prohibited gambling,
b) makes premises or equipment available for the regular organisation of prohibited gambling, or
c) invites to participate in prohibited gambling before a large public,
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment not exceeding three years.

## 361. § Whoever *

a) violates the rules of epidemiological isolation, observation, quarantine or control ordered to prevent the introduction or spread of an infectious disease subject to quarantine obligation,
b) during an epidemic violates the rules of epidemiological isolation, observation, quarantine or control ordered,
c) violates the rules of plant health or animal epidemic measures ordered to prevent or eliminate the introduction and removal, as well as the spread of infectious animal diseases or plant quarantine pests,
shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by confinement.

## 362. § Whoever in the European Union

a) unlawfully brings into the territory of the country, stores, transports, places on the market or releases into the environment propagating material of a genetically modified plant variety not authorised,
b) unlawfully releases into the environment propagating material of a genetically modified plant variety authorised for purposes not extending to cultivation use,
c) violates the prohibition on import, production, storage, transport, placing on the market or use ordered as a safety measure for the duration of the safeguard procedure in respect of propagating material of a genetically modified plant variety authorised for cultivation purposes,
shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding two years.

## 363. §

(1) Whoever violates his or her obligation to cooperate as defined in the Act on the State Audit Office during an audit by the State Audit Office, and thereby obstructs the conduct of the audit, shall be punishable for a misdemeanour by imprisonment not exceeding two years.  
(2) The head of the audited organisation shall be punishable according to paragraph (1) if, despite a written request, he or she does not send an action plan to the State Audit Office.  
(3) The punishment shall be imprisonment not exceeding three years for a felony if the act defined in paragraph (1) frustrates the conduct of the audit.

## 364. §

* Expulsion may also be imposed on the perpetrator of people smuggling, illegal crossing of the border barrier, damaging the border barrier, obstructing construction work related to the border barrier, facilitating illegal residence, facilitating and supporting illegal immigration, and organising prohibited gambling.

## 365. §

(1) Whoever takes away another's property from another person for the purpose of unlawful appropriation in such a way that for this purpose
a) applies violence against someone, or direct threat against life or bodily integrity, or
b) places them in an unconscious or defenseless state,
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from two to eight years.  
(2) Robbery also occurs if a thief caught in the act applies violence or direct threat against life or bodily integrity for the purpose of retaining the property.  
(3) The punishment is imprisonment from five to ten years if the robbery is committed
a) while armed,
b) while equipped with weapons,
c) in a group,
d) in a criminal association,
e) for significant value,
f) against an official person, foreign official person or person performing public duties, during their official proceedings or performance of their duties,
g) against a person with limited capacity to recognize or avert the crime due to their old age or disability.  
(4) The punishment is imprisonment from five to fifteen years if the robbery is committed
a) for particularly high value or exceeding that,
b) for significant value in the manner specified in points a)–d) of paragraph (3),
c) against an official person, foreign official person or person performing public duties, during their official proceedings or performance of their duties, in the manner specified in points a)–d) of paragraph (3).  
(5) Whoever commits preparation for robbery shall be punishable for a misdemeanor by imprisonment up to two years.

## 366. § (1) Whoever takes away another's property for the purpose of unlawful appropriation

a) by intoxicating them or inducing their stupefied state for this purpose,
b) takes it from a person who is under the effect of violence or direct threat against life or bodily integrity applied by them during the commission of another crime, or
c) takes it from a person who is defenseless or has limited capacity to recognize or avert the crime due to their old age or disability,
shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from one to five years.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment from two to eight years if the plundering is committed
a) for significant value,
b) in a group,
c) in a criminal association.  
(3) The punishment is imprisonment from five to ten years if the plundering is committed
a) for particularly high value or exceeding that,
b) for significant value, in a group or in a criminal association.

## 367. §

(1) Whoever, for the purpose of unlawful gain, compels another by violence or threat to do, not do or tolerate something, and thereby causes financial disadvantage, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from one to five years.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment from two to eight years if the extortion is committed
a) in a criminal association,
b) with threat against life or bodily integrity, or other similarly serious threat,
c) as an official person using this capacity,
d) by simulating official mandate or capacity.

## 368. §

(1) Whoever, for the purpose of enforcing a lawful or allegedly lawful financial claim, compels another by violence or threat to do, not do or tolerate something, shall be punishable for a felony by imprisonment from one to five years.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment from two to eight years if the vigilantism is committed
a) while armed,
b) while equipped with weapons,
c) in a group,
d) against a defenseless person.  
(3) Vigilantism does not occur if the application of violence or threat is a permitted means of enforcing the claim.

## 369. §

For the purposes of this chapter, for the purposes of special recidivism, similar offenses are violent crimes against property and crimes against property.

## 370. §

* (1) Whoever takes away another's property from another person in order to unlawfully appropriate it commits theft.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment up to two years for a misdemeanor if
a) the theft is committed for minor value or
b) the theft committed for petty offense value is committed
ba) in a criminal association,
bb) habitually,
bc) with violence against property – including the removal of a device serving to prevent the appropriation of the property without causing damage to its substance, or rendering the device incapable of preventing the appropriation of the property –,
bd) by pickpocketing,
be) with the simultaneous taking of one or more public documents, private documents or cash substitute payment instruments,
bf) by entering a premises or enclosed area belonging to it by deception, or without the knowledge and consent of the entitled person or user,
bg) using a false or stolen key,
bh) against a victim sharing a dwelling or similar premises with the perpetrator, or
bi) by unlawful tree felling in a forest.  
(3) The punishment is imprisonment up to three years for a felony if
a) the theft is committed for higher value,
b) the theft committed for minor value is committed
ba) in one of the manners specified in points ba)–be) of paragraph (2),
bb) * for an object belonging to protected cultural assets, archaeological find or movable cultural heritage element under foreign protection,
bc) for an object of religious veneration,
bd) for an object on a corpse, or for an object dedicated to the memory of the deceased in a cemetery or burial memorial site,
be) for precious metal, or
c) the theft is committed for petty offense or minor value at the scene of public danger.  
(4) The punishment is imprisonment from one to five years if
a) the theft is committed for significant value, or
b) the theft committed for higher value is committed in one of the manners specified in points ba)–be) of paragraph (2) or at the scene of public danger.  
(5) The punishment is imprisonment from two to eight years if
a) the theft is committed for particularly high value, or
b) the theft committed for significant value is committed in one of the manners specified in points ba)–be) of paragraph (2) or at the scene of public danger.  
(6) The punishment is imprisonment from five to ten years if
a) the theft is committed for particularly significant value, or
b) the theft committed for particularly high value is committed in one of the manners specified in points ba)–be) of paragraph (2) or at the scene of public danger.

## 371. §

(1) Whoever causes damage by destroying or damaging another's property commits vandalism.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment up to one year for a misdemeanor if
a) the vandalism causes minor damage, or
b) the vandalism causing damage not exceeding the petty offense value threshold is committed
ba) by placing graffiti, or
bb) in a criminal association.  
(3) The punishment is imprisonment up to three years for a felony if
a) the vandalism causes higher damage,
b) the perpetrator damages
ba) * an object belonging to protected cultural assets, a monument, archaeological site, archaeological find or cultural heritage element under foreign protection,
bb) * an object of religious veneration or a church, other place designated for religious practice,
bc) a burial place, burial memorial site, or an object dedicated to the memory of the deceased in a cemetery or burial memorial site.  
(4) The punishment is imprisonment from one to five years if
a) the vandalism causes significant damage,
b) the perpetrator destroys an object, building or place specified in points ba)–bc) of paragraph (3),
c) the vandalism is committed using explosives or explosive devices.  
(5) The punishment is imprisonment from two to eight years if the vandalism causes particularly high damage.  
(6) The punishment is imprisonment from five to ten years if the vandalism causes particularly significant damage.  
(7) For the purposes of this §, graffiti means: a pictorial, graphic or textual surface coating created with spray paint, marker pen or any other surface-forming material, which is not necessary for the proper use of the property.

(1) Aki a rábízott idegen dolgot jogtalanul eltulajdonítja, vagy azzal sajátjaként rendelkezik, sikkasztást követ el.

## 373. §

(1) Aki jogtalan haszonszerzés végett mást tévedésbe ejt, vagy tévedésben tart, és ezzel kárt okoz, csalást követ el.  
(2) A büntetés vétség miatt két évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha

b) a szabálysértési értékhatárt meg nem haladó kárt okozó csalást
ba) bűnszövetségben,
bb) közveszély színhelyén,
bc) üzletszerűen,
bd) jótékony célú adománygyűjtést színlelve
követik el.  
(3) A büntetés bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) a csalás nagyobb kárt okoz, vagy
b) a kisebb kárt okozó csalást a (2) bekezdés ba)–bc) pontjában meghatározott valamely módon követik el.  
(4) A büntetés egy évtől öt évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) a csalás jelentős kárt okoz,
b) a nagyobb kárt okozó csalást a (2) bekezdés ba)–bc) pontjában meghatározott valamely módon követik el, vagy
c) a csalást a bűncselekmény felismerésére vagy elhárítására idős koránál vagy fogyatékosságánál fogva korlátozottan képes személy sérelmére követik el.

a) a csalás különösen nagy kárt okoz, vagy
b) a jelentős kárt okozó csalást a (2) bekezdés ba)–bc) pontjában meghatározott valamely módon követik el.  
(6) A büntetés öt évtől tíz évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) a csalás különösen jelentős kárt okoz, vagy
b) a különösen nagy kárt okozó csalást a (2) bekezdés ba)–bc) pontjában meg határozott valamely módon követi kel.  
(7) E § alkalmazása szempontjából kárnak kell tekinteni az igénybe vett szolgáltatás meg nem fizetett ellenértékét is.

## 374. §

(1) Aki jogtalan haszonszerzés végett színlelt gazdasági tevékenységet végez, és ezzel vagyoni hátrányt okoz, gazdasági csalást követ el.  
(2) A büntetés vétség miatt két évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha a gazdasági csalás kisebb vagyoni hátrányt okoz.  
(3) A büntetés bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) a gazdasági csalás nagyobb vagyoni hátrányt okoz, vagy
b) a kisebb vagyoni hátrányt okozó gazdasági csalást
ba) bűnszövetségben,
bb) üzletszerűen
követik el.  
(4) A büntetés egy évtől öt évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) a gazdasági csalás jelentős vagyoni hátrányt okoz, vagy
b) a nagyobb vagyoni hátrányt okozó gazdasági csalást a (3) bekezdés ba) vagy bb) pontjában meghatározott módon követik el.  
(5) A büntetés két évtől nyolc évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) a gazdasági csalás különösen nagy vagyoni hátrányt okoz, vagy
b) a jelentős vagyoni hátrányt okozó gazdasági csalást a (3) bekezdés ba) vagy bb) pontjában meghatározott módon követik el.  
(6) A büntetés öt évtől tíz évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) a gazdasági csalás különösen jelentős vagyoni hátrányt okoz, vagy
b) a különösen nagy vagyoni hátrányt okozó gazdasági csalást a (3) bekezdés ba) vagy bb) pontjában meghatározott módon követik el.

## 375. §

(1) Aki jogtalan haszonszerzés végett információs rendszerbe adatot bevisz, az abban kezelt adatot megváltoztatja, törli, vagy hozzáférhetetlenné teszi, illetve egyéb művelet végzésével az információs rendszer működését befolyásolja, és ezzel kárt okoz, bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.  
(2) A büntetés egy évtől öt évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) az információs rendszer felhasználásával elkövetett csalás jelentős kárt okoz, vagy
b) a nagyobb kárt okozó információs rendszer felhasználásával elkövetett csalást bűnszövetségben vagy üzletszerűen követik el.  
(3) A büntetés két évtől nyolc évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) az információs rendszer felhasználásával elkövetett csalás különösen nagy kárt okoz, vagy
b) a jelentős kárt okozó információs rendszer felhasználásával elkövetett csalást bűnszövetségben vagy üzletszerűen követik el.  
(4) A büntetés öt évtől tíz évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) az információs rendszer felhasználásával elkövetett csalás különösen jelentős kárt okoz, vagy
b) a különösen nagy kárt okozó információs rendszer felhasználásával elkövetett csalást bűnszövetségben vagy üzletszerűen követik el.  
(5) Az (1)–(4) bekezdés szerint büntetendő, aki hamis, hamisított vagy jogosulatlanul megszerzett elektronikus készpénz-helyettesítő fizetési eszköz felhasználásával vagy az ilyen eszközzel történő fizetés elfogadásával okoz kárt.  
(6) Az (5) bekezdés alkalmazásában a külföldön kibocsátott elektronikus készpénz-helyettesítő fizetési eszköz a belföldön kibocsátott készpénz-helyettesítő fizetési eszközzel azonos védelemben részesül.

## 376. §

(1) Akit idegen vagyon kezelésével bíztak meg, és ebből folyó kötelességének megszegésével vagyoni hátrányt okoz, hűtlen kezelést követ el.  
(2) A büntetés vétség miatt két évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) a hűtlen kezelés kisebb vagyoni hátrányt okoz, vagy
b) a szabálysértési értékhatárt meg nem haladó vagyoni hátrányt okozó hűtlen kezelést gyám vagy gondnok e minőségében követi el.  
(3) A büntetés bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) a hűtlen kezelés nagyobb vagyoni hátrányt okoz, vagy
b) a kisebb vagyoni hátrányt okozó hűtlen kezelést gyám vagy gondnok e minőségében követi el.  
(4) A büntetés egy évtől öt évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) a hűtlen kezelés jelentős vagyoni hátrányt okoz, vagy
b) a nagyobb vagyoni hátrányt okozó hűtlen kezelést gyám vagy gondnok e minőségében követi el.  
(5) A büntetés két évtől nyolc évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) a hűtlen kezelés különösen nagy vagyoni hátrányt okoz, vagy
b) a jelentős vagyoni hátrányt okozó hűtlen kezelést gyám vagy gondnok e minőségében e minőségében követi el.  
(6) A büntetés öt évtől tíz évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha
a) a hűtlen kezelés különösen jelentős vagyoni hátrányt okoz, vagy
b) a különösen nagy vagyoni hátrányt okozó hűtlen kezelést gyám vagy gondnok e minőségében követi el.

## 377. §

(1) Akit idegen vagyon törvényen alapuló kezelésével vagy felügyeletével bíztak meg, és az ebből eredő kötelességének megszegésével vagy elhanyagolásával gondatlanságból vagyoni hátrányt okoz, vétség miatt két évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.  
(2) A büntetés három évig terjedő szabadságvesztés, ha a hanyag kezelés különösen nagy vagy ezt meghaladó vagyoni hátrányt okoz.

## 372. §

(1) A person who unlawfully misappropriates property of another entrusted to them, or disposes of it as their own, commits embezzlement.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment not exceeding two years for a misdemeanor, if
a) the embezzlement is committed for a lesser value or
b) the embezzlement committed for a petty offense value is committed
ba) in a criminal association,
bb) at the scene of a public danger,
bc) on a commercial basis.  
(3) The punishment is imprisonment not exceeding three years for a felony, if
a) the embezzlement is committed for a greater value,
b) the embezzlement committed for a lesser value is committed in any of the ways specified in points ba)–bc) of paragraph (2), or
c) * the embezzlement is committed in respect of an object belonging to the category of protected cultural property, an archaeological find or a movable cultural heritage element under foreign protection.  
(4) The punishment is imprisonment from one year to five years, if
a) the embezzlement is committed for a significant value,
b) the embezzlement committed for a greater value is committed in any of the ways specified in points ba)–bc) of paragraph (2), or
c) the embezzlement is committed to the detriment of a person with limited capacity to recognize or avert the offense due to their advanced age or disability.  
(5) The punishment is imprisonment from two years to eight years, if
a) the embezzlement is committed for a particularly large value or
b) the embezzlement committed for a significant value is committed in any of the ways specified in points ba)–bc) of paragraph (2).  
(6) The punishment is imprisonment from five years to ten years, if
a) the embezzlement is committed for a particularly significant value or
b) the embezzlement committed for a particularly large value is committed in any of the ways specified in points ba)–bc) of paragraph (2).

## 373. §

(1) A person who, for the purpose of unlawful gain, deceives another or maintains another in error, and thereby causes damage, commits fraud.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment not exceeding two years for a misdemeanor, if
a) the fraud causes lesser damage, or
b) the fraud causing damage not exceeding the petty offense value threshold is committed
ba) in a criminal association,
bb) at the scene of a public danger,
bc) on a commercial basis,
bd) by simulating a charitable fundraising campaign.  
(3) The punishment is imprisonment not exceeding three years for a felony, if
a) the fraud causes greater damage, or
b) the fraud causing lesser damage is committed in any of the ways specified in points ba)–bc) of paragraph (2).  
(4) The punishment is imprisonment from one year to five years, if
a) the fraud causes significant damage,
b) the fraud causing greater damage is committed in any of the ways specified in points ba)–bc) of paragraph (2), or
c) the fraud is committed to the detriment of a person with limited capacity to recognize or avert the offense due to their advanced age or disability.  
(5) The punishment is imprisonment from two years to eight years, if
a) the fraud causes particularly large damage, or
b) the fraud causing significant damage is committed in any of the ways specified in points ba)–bc) of paragraph (2).  
(6) The punishment is imprisonment from five years to ten years, if
a) the fraud causes particularly significant damage, or
b) the fraud causing particularly large damage is committed in any of the ways specified in points ba)–bc) of paragraph (2).  
(7) For the purposes of this §, damage shall also include the unpaid consideration for a service received.

## 374. §

(1) A person who, for the purpose of unlawful gain, conducts simulated economic activity, and thereby causes pecuniary disadvantage, commits economic fraud.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment not exceeding two years for a misdemeanor, if the economic fraud causes lesser pecuniary disadvantage.  
(3) The punishment is imprisonment not exceeding three years for a felony, if
a) the economic fraud causes greater pecuniary disadvantage, or
b) the economic fraud causing lesser pecuniary disadvantage is committed
ba) in a criminal association,
bb) on a commercial basis.  
(4) The punishment is imprisonment from one year to five years, if
a) the economic fraud causes significant pecuniary disadvantage, or
b) the economic fraud causing greater pecuniary disadvantage is committed in the manner specified in point ba) or bb) of paragraph (3).  
(5) The punishment is imprisonment from two years to eight years, if
a) the economic fraud causes particularly large pecuniary disadvantage, or
b) the economic fraud causing significant pecuniary disadvantage is committed in the manner specified in point ba) or bb) of paragraph (3).  
(6) The punishment is imprisonment from five years to ten years, if
a) the economic fraud causes particularly significant pecuniary disadvantage, or
b) the economic fraud causing particularly large pecuniary disadvantage is committed in the manner specified in point ba) or bb) of paragraph (3).

## 375. §

(1) A person who, for the purpose of unlawful gain, enters data into an information system, modifies, deletes or makes inaccessible data processed therein, or influences the operation of the information system by performing other operations, and thereby causes damage, is punishable by imprisonment not exceeding three years for a felony.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment from one year to five years, if
a) the fraud committed by using an information system causes significant damage, or
b) the fraud committed by using an information system causing greater damage is committed in a criminal association or on a commercial basis.  
(3) The punishment is imprisonment from two years to eight years, if
a) the fraud committed by using an information system causes particularly large damage, or
b) the fraud committed by using an information system causing significant damage is committed in a criminal association or on a commercial basis.  
(4) The punishment is imprisonment from five years to ten years, if
a) the fraud committed by using an information system causes particularly significant damage, or
b) the fraud committed by using an information system causing particularly large damage is committed in a criminal association or on a commercial basis.  
(5) A person who causes damage by using a false, falsified or unlawfully obtained electronic cash-substitute payment instrument or by accepting payment with such an instrument is punishable under paragraphs (1)–(4).  
(6) For the purposes of paragraph (5), an electronic cash-substitute payment instrument issued abroad shall be afforded the same protection as a cash-substitute payment instrument issued domestically.

## 376. §

(1) A person who has been entrusted with the management of property of another, and causes pecuniary disadvantage by breaching the obligation arising therefrom, commits breach of fiduciary duty.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment not exceeding two years for a misdemeanor, if
a) the breach of fiduciary duty causes lesser pecuniary disadvantage, or
b) the breach of fiduciary duty causing pecuniary disadvantage not exceeding the petty offense value threshold is committed by a guardian or custodian in that capacity.  
(3) The punishment is imprisonment not exceeding three years for a felony, if
a) the breach of fiduciary duty causes greater pecuniary disadvantage, or
b) the breach of fiduciary duty causing lesser pecuniary disadvantage is committed by a guardian or custodian in that capacity.  
(4) The punishment is imprisonment from one year to five years, if
a) the breach of fiduciary duty causes significant pecuniary disadvantage, or
b) the breach of fiduciary duty causing greater pecuniary disadvantage is committed by a guardian or custodian in that capacity.  
(5) The punishment is imprisonment from two years to eight years, if
a) the breach of fiduciary duty causes particularly large pecuniary disadvantage, or
b) the breach of fiduciary duty causing significant pecuniary disadvantage is committed by a guardian or custodian in that capacity.  
(6) The punishment is imprisonment from five years to ten years, if
a) the breach of fiduciary duty causes particularly significant pecuniary disadvantage, or
b) the breach of fiduciary duty causing particularly large pecuniary disadvantage is committed by a guardian or custodian in that capacity.

## 377. §

(1) A person who has been entrusted with the management or supervision of property of another based on law, and causes pecuniary disadvantage by negligently breaching or neglecting the obligation arising therefrom, is punishable by imprisonment not exceeding two years for a misdemeanor.  
(2) The punishment is imprisonment not exceeding three years, if the negligent management causes particularly large or greater pecuniary disadvantage.

## 380. §

(1) Aki idegen gépi meghajtású járművet mástól azért vesz el, hogy jogtalanul használja, vagy az így elvett, illetve a rábízott ilyen járművet használja jogtalanul, bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.

(1) Aki más rászorult helyzetét kihasználva olyan különösen aránytalan mértékű ellenszolgáltatást tartalmazó megállapodást köt, amely alkalmas arra, hogy annak teljesítése a megállapodás kötelezettjét, a megállapodás kötelezettjének a vele közös háztartásban élő hozzátartozóját, illetve a megállapodás kötelezettje által tartási kötelezettség alapján eltartott személyt súlyos vagy további súlyos nélkülözésnek tegye ki, bűntett miatt három évig terjedő szabadságvesztéssel büntetendő.
